title: Browser-verify runner extension: blueprint-shipped probe pack loader, scoping predicate, aggregate verdict and --probe-pack CLI
summary: T-0 of the ratified visual round (spec 2026-09-04, section 2.1): the browser-verify runner extension that lets a blueprint ship a Playwright probe pack under `blueprints/<slug>/probe-packs/` and have `rcf verify browser` discover, scope-check and run it as a required ship gate. Six ACs span the loader (schema + `.pack.js` and `.pack.mjs`), the applicability predicate (source-scan for one of the three legal scoping seams: route, tacIds or `blueprint:` tag), the check-id cross-check against the shipping blueprint's contributed AC ids, the runner pass (after invariants and auth-smoke, packs receive an injected browser and fetch), the aggregate verdict extension (block on any `severity: block` pack fail), the `--probe-pack <name>` CLI restriction, and the optional `preChecks[]` fast-fail slot with `dependsOn` skip semantics. Zero new npm dependencies; the pinned Playwright MCP the launcher provisions is the browser access seam. Unblocks T-1..T-5 (datatable, charts, dashboard, notifications-in-app, admin-console).
